lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs posterior to the gill slits are organized in a semi-ordered grid, with approximately five primary vertical columns visible between the pectoral fin and the posterior frame edge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with the centroids of the primary blobs, forming a discernible coordinate system across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible horizontal carinae on the upper third of the flank exhibit a light-to-dark gradient, defining three parallel longitudinal ridges.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density, heterogeneous distribution of smaller circular high-intensity pixel clusters.
